mean_cn: n.风景，景色；观点，看法；  v.把……视为；看待；观看
mean_en: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful countryside; used when you are talking about whether you can see something or whether something can be seen in a particular situation.
sentence: What an amazing view from the top of the hill!
sentence_trans: 从山顶看到的风景太棒啦！
